question: Sindhudurg Fort is located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Maharashtra.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Sindhudurg Fort is located in Maharashtra.
 
• It was built by Shivaji in 1664.
 
• Its main architect was Hirojee Indulkar.
 
• The main objective to build this fort was to counter the rising influence of foreign( English, Dutch, French, Portuguese) merchants.
 
• It was built on Khurte Island.
 
• Now it is controlled by the Government of India.
